scoring_justification: Compute-driven DFT NEB; verifier cannot recompute barriers from raw artifacts, only compare reported values to paper gold within tolerance.

outputs.description: Computed Li ion migration energy barriers (eV) for the four electronic/structural cases: Ti_I³⁺, Ti_II³⁺, Ti_III³⁺, and All‑Ti⁴⁺. The checker will compare these values to reference values within an appropriate tolerance and optionally verify the relative ordering consistent with the paper.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces only the single-Li migration barriers in spinel TiO₂. The Li vacancy migration in LiTi₂O₄ and the bond-length/trapping-energy analysis are excluded as they are out of scope for this reproduction.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 2b and text: TiI3+ 0.480 eV, TiII3+ 0.595 eV, TiIII3+ 0.636 eV, All-Ti4+ 0.602 eV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values verified against paper source and reference solve.sh

steps.description: Compare reported Li migration barriers to paper gold within ±0.05 eV each. Average across the four cases gives the step score.
